📜 CHAMA CONSTITUTION

This Constitution outlines the rules, structure, and operations of the chama and shall guide all members.

👥 Article 1: Membership

  • Registration and Records:
    • Every member must register officially with the chama and provide accurate personal and contact details.
    • Members are required to update their information whenever changes occur.
  • Admission of Members:
    • New members may only join after approval by existing members or leadership.
    • This ensures trust, accountability, and harmony within the group.
  • Active Membership Requirement:
    • Membership shall be confirmed after a minimum of four (4) months of active participation.
    • Active participation includes consistent contributions, engagement in meetings, and compliance with chama rules.
  • 🔄 Merry-Go-Round Participation Rule:
    • Members are encouraged to participate in the merry-go-round system as part of group financial support.
    • 📌 Members who are not participating in the merry-go-round are required to actively contribute to savings without fail.
    • This ensures fairness and guarantees that all members remain eligible for welfare and other chama benefits.
    • Failure to participate in either savings or contributions may affect a member’s active status and benefits.
  • 🆕 Registration Fee (Effective January 2027):
    • All new members shall pay a one-time registration fee of Ksh 500.
    • This fee shall be used for administrative and logistical support, especially during physical meetings.
  • 💡 Contribution Categories (From 2026):
    • 💎 Category A: Weekly contribution of Ksh 300 + minimum savings of Ksh 50. Estimated monthly savings: Ksh 200.
    • 💼 Category B: Contribution of Ksh 500 twice a month + minimum savings of Ksh 50. Estimated monthly savings: Ksh 300.
  • 📌 General Principle:
    • All members must remain active through either savings or merry-go-round participation.
    • Consistency, discipline, and commitment define full membership eligibility and benefits.

💰 Article 2: Savings & Contributions

  • Contribution Requirement:
    • Every member must contribute according to their chosen category without fail.
    • All contributions must be made consistently to ensure smooth operation of the chama.
  • Importance of Savings:
    • Savings above the minimum are highly encouraged as they improve financial stability and increase loan eligibility.
    • Consistent saving reflects discipline, commitment, and trustworthiness within the chama.
  • ⏰ Payment Deadlines:
    • All weekly or bi-monthly contributions must be submitted on or before the agreed deadlines.
    • Timely payments ensure smooth financial planning and group stability.
  • ⚠️ Penalties for Late Payment:
    • Failure to pay by the deadline shall attract a fine of Ksh 30.
    • The fine will be added to the member’s account and must be cleared accordingly.
  • 📊 Transparency and Records:
    • All savings and contribution records shall be transparent and accessible to members at any time.
    • Members are encouraged to regularly check their records for accuracy.
  • 💞 Welfare Eligibility Requirement:
    • To qualify for any welfare support, a member must have total savings of at least Ksh 2,000 and above.
    • Members with savings below this threshold shall not be eligible for welfare benefits such as emergency support, wedding, or funeral assistance.
    • Members who do not actively participate in savings are not eligible for welfare support or Chama loans.
    • Members on the Savings Only plan may be considered for welfare or loans only after meeting the applicable minimum savings and all other eligibility requirements; they do not qualify for Merry-Go-Round payouts.
    • This rule ensures fairness and sustainability of the chama welfare fund.
  • 🔄 Merry-Go-Round Participation Safety Rule:
    • Members who participate in the Merry-Go-Round but do not actively participate in savings may not receive an early payout when the Merry-Go-Round payout/turn list is being prepared. Early payout priority will consider active savings participation, contribution consistency and compliance with approved Chama rules. Merry-Go-Round participation alone does not guarantee an early payout.
    • Members are encouraged to actively participate in the merry-go-round system to enjoy full group benefits.
    • 📌 Members whose savings are below the required minimum or below agreed contribution levels may not receive merry-go-round payouts early.
    • This measure is put in place to ensure financial safety, fairness, and sustainability of the chama funds.
    • Priority in merry-go-round payouts shall be given to members who are consistent in savings and contributions.
    • 📌 Saving Discipline:
      • Members are strongly encouraged to save consistently in order to strengthen their financial position within the chama.

    • 🏆 Savings Reward System:
        ```
      • Members with total savings of 1500 or more and active for at least 10 months shall qualify for the highest reward rate of 80%, while the remaining 20% shall be retained as group capital.
      • Members with total savings of 1500 or more and active for at least 6 months shall qualify for a 75% reward rate, while the remaining 25% shall be retained as group capital.
      • Members with total savings of 1000 or more but who do not meet the above conditions shall qualify for a 30% reward rate, while the remaining 70% shall be retained as group capital.
      • 📌 Reward percentages may be reviewed depending on the financial position and sustainability of the group.
      ```

    • 📢 Exit Settlement:
        ```
      • Any member who exits the chama shall receive 100% of their savings after clearing all outstanding obligations.
      ```

    🏦 Article 3: Loans

    • 📅 Annual Loan Operating Period and Closure:
      • The chama's normal loan operating period shall run annually from 1 January to 31 October.
      • Loan applications and new loan disbursements shall close from 1 November to 31 December each year.
      • The annual closure shall allow the chama to prepare for its December activities and the close of the year.
      • Normal loan services shall resume on 1 January of the following year, subject to the availability of funds and the usual approval requirements.
    • Loan Eligibility:
      • A member qualifies for a loan after saving at least Ksh 1,500.
      • The member must have been active in the chama for at least four (4) months.
      • Active participation includes consistent savings, contributions, and adherence to chama rules.
      • Loans shall also be assessed based on the member's savings history, consistency, and financial discipline.
      • Priority shall be given to members with higher savings balances.
      • Members actively participating in the Monthly Merry-Go-Round may receive additional consideration during loan assessment.
    • Loan Assessment Criteria:
      • Loans shall be issued based on the member’s savings history and consistency.
      • Discipline and commitment within the chama shall be considered.
      • The member’s ability to repay within the agreed period will also be assessed.
      • The leadership shall also consider the availability of loan funds before approving any application.
    • 📝 Loan Application Requirements:
      • Every loan application shall be completed using the official Loan Application Form.
      • The application must include the member's Next of Kin details.
      • The application must also include the details of the proposed Guarantor(s).
      • All guarantors must be active members of the chama.
    • 📌 Loan Approval:
      • All loan requests must be approved by both the Admin and Chairlady.
      • Approval shall ensure fairness, accountability, and proper fund management.
      • The leadership reserves the right to reject or adjust loan requests based on available funds.
      • Once all loan requirements have been met, loan approval shall normally take approximately 10 minutes.
      • Every approved loan shall remain subject to the chama's Loan Terms and Conditions.
    • ⏳ Loan Repayment Terms:
      • All loans must be repaid within the agreed timeframe.
      • Any member who fails to repay a loan within the required period shall be charged a penalty of Ksh 10 per day until the loan is fully repaid.
      • Loans above Ksh 5,000 with a repayment period of one (1) month or two (2) months may be granted a one-week extension period upon approval by the Admin and Chairlady.
      • Once the extension period expires, the daily penalty of Ksh 10 shall immediately apply until full repayment is made.
      • Late repayment may attract restrictions on future borrowing.
      • Repeated default may lead to suspension of loan privileges.
    • 💸 Interest Distribution Policy:
      • Upon loan repayment, the interest earned shall be shared as follows:
      • 🌿 20% is credited back to the borrower’s personal savings account.
      • 🤝 80% is distributed among all members based on their savings ratio.
    • 📘 Fairness and Sustainability:
      • This system ensures fairness among members and rewards consistent savers.
      • It also strengthens the financial stability and growth of the chama.
      • All loan activities shall be recorded transparently for accountability.
      • As the group's savings continue to grow, the chama may introduce larger loan limits subject to approval by members.

    🧑‍💼 Article 4: Leadership

    • The chama shall have two key leadership roles:
    • 💰 Founder & Admin Roles:
      • Oversee all financial management of the chama.
      • Maintain accurate records of savings, contributions, and balances.
      • Control and safeguard all group funds.
      • Approve and process loan requests together with the Chairlady.
      • Track loan repayments and ensure compliance with terms.
      • Communicate important updates, deadlines, and announcements.
      • Prepare and present financial reports to members.
      • Ensure transparency and accountability in all financial matters.
      • Coordinate overall operations of the chama.
    • 👩‍💼 Chairlady Roles:
      • Represent the interests and welfare of all members.
      • Coordinate group activities, meetings, and discussions.
      • Work closely with the Admin to ensure smooth operations.
      • Assist in approval of loans and welfare requests.
      • Ensure discipline, unity, and fairness among members.
      • Handle member concerns, conflicts, and feedback.
      • Mobilize members for meetings and participation.
      • Support enforcement of the constitution and rules.
    • General Leadership Provisions:
      • The Chairlady shall be elected by members.
      • The term of service shall be one (1) year.
      • Members may re-elect or extend the term based on performance.
      • The Admin and Chairlady shall work together to ensure transparency, fairness, and unity.
      • Leadership must ensure proper tracking of contributions, savings, loans, and welfare matters.
      • Regular updates on finances and chama activities shall be shared with all members.

    💞 Article 5: Welfare Support

    • 🤝 Welfare Support Package:
      • The chama shall provide a KSh 8,000 Welfare Support Package to eligible active members during approved welfare events.
      • The welfare package shall apply to the following events:
        • 👶 Newborn Baby Support
        • 💍 Wedding Support
        • 🕊️ Burial Support
    • 🕊️ Burial Support Eligibility:
      • Burial support shall be provided in the event of the loss of:
        • A parent.
        • A guardian (where the member has no surviving parent).
        • A son or daughter.
      • In exceptional circumstances, the group may approve support for the loss of a biological brother or biological sister upon members' agreement.
    • 💰 Contribution Method:
      • The KSh 8,000 welfare amount shall be contributed collectively by members based on the current active membership.
      • Members may either:
        • Make a direct contribution; or
        • Authorize the amount to be deducted from their savings.
    • ✅ Eligibility:
      • Only active members shall qualify for welfare support.
      • A member must have active savings of at least KSh 2,00 at the time assistance is requested.
      • Members with savings below KSh 2,000 must first increase their savings to the minimum qualifying amount before becoming eligible.
    • 🪪 Member Identification:
      • Every member applying for welfare support shall provide a clear copy of their National Identity Card (ID) or any other government-issued identification document.
      • The identification document shall be submitted together with the required supporting documents.
      • The Admin shall keep all identification documents confidential and use them only for verification and record-keeping purposes.
    • 🔍 Verification of Welfare Requests:
      • Every welfare request shall be supported by appropriate documents before approval.
      • 👶 Newborn Baby Support:
        • Copy of the member's National ID.
        • Birth Notification issued by a health facility; or
        • Birth Certificate (if available); or
        • Hospital discharge documents confirming the birth.
      • 💍 Wedding Support:
        • Copy of the member's National ID.
        • Wedding invitation card; or
        • Marriage Certificate (if available); or
        • Confirmation letter from the church, mosque, registrar, or officiating authority.
      • 🕊️ Burial Support:
        • Copy of the member's National ID.
        • Burial Permit; or
        • Death Notification from a hospital or relevant authority; or
        • Funeral Programme; or
        • Obituary or funeral announcement; or
        • Any other acceptable document approved by the members.
    • 👥 Verification Committee:
      • The Chairlady and the Admin shall verify every welfare request before it is presented to members for approval.
      • Where necessary, they may contact family members, religious leaders, local administrators, hospitals, or other reliable persons to confirm the information provided.
    • 🗳️ Approval Procedure:
      • The welfare request shall first be verified by the Chairlady and Admin.
      • The verified request shall then be presented to members through an official meeting or the group's approved communication platform.
      • The approval and supporting documents shall be recorded by the Admin for accountability.
    • ⚠️ False Information:
      • Any member found to have knowingly submitted false information or forged documents to obtain welfare support shall not receive the welfare support.
      • Such a member shall lose eligibility for welfare benefits for twelve (6) months.
      • The member may also face disciplinary action, including suspension or expulsion, in accordance with this Constitution.
    • 📁 Record Keeping:
      • The Admin shall securely maintain records of all welfare applications, supporting documents, approvals, payments, and verification reports for future reference and auditing.
    • 📢 Notification Requirement:
      • Members shall notify the Chairlady or Admin as early as reasonably possible for all planned welfare-related events to allow proper planning and coordination.
    • 🤝 Additional Assistance:
      • Additional support may be considered by members depending on the circumstances and availability of funds.
      • Every request shall be discussed and approved transparently during a members' meeting.
    • 📌 Resolution:
      • The Welfare Support Package was unanimously approved by members and shall take effect immediately upon adoption of these Constitution and Rules.

    🤝 Article 6: Conduct

    • General Code of Conduct:
      • All members shall uphold respect, honesty, integrity, and transparency in all chama activities.
      • Members shall act in good faith and prioritize the unity and growth of the chama.
    • 🤝 Respect and Interpersonal Relations:
      • Members shall treat one another with respect, dignity, and fairness at all times.
      • Abusive language, harassment, or discrimination of any kind shall not be tolerated.
      • Members shall resolve disagreements peacefully and professionally.
    • 📅 Participation and Meetings:
      • Members are expected to attend all scheduled meetings and group activities.
      • In case of absence, members must communicate in advance to the leadership.
      • Active participation in discussions and decisions is encouraged.
    • 📢 Communication:
      • Members shall communicate clearly, honestly, and respectfully in all group platforms.
      • Official communication channels of the chama must be used for updates and announcements.
      • Misleading or false information shall not be shared.
    • 🔒 Confidentiality:
      • All group matters, including financial records and member information, shall remain confidential.
      • Members shall not disclose internal chama information to outsiders without approval.
    • 📌 Member Responsibility:
      • Members shall take responsibility for their financial commitments and obligations.
      • Members shall comply with all rules outlined in this constitution.
      • Any issues or concerns shall be reported promptly to the leadership.

    ⚖️ Article 7: Discipline

    • General Principle:
      • All members are expected to uphold discipline, responsibility, and commitment to the chama.
      • Failure to follow the constitution and agreed rules shall attract appropriate action.
    • 📌 Failure to Meet Obligations:
      • Late or missed contributions shall attract penalties as defined in Article 2.
      • Repeated failure to contribute may lead to warnings and possible suspension.
      • Members with continuous default may lose eligibility for loans and welfare benefits.
    • 🔄 Merry-Go-Round Contribution Discipline:
      • Members are required to pay their Merry-Go-Round contribution on or before the agreed due date.
      • A member who misses one Merry-Go-Round payment without a valid reason shall receive a warning and be required to clear the missed contribution immediately.
      • A member who misses two consecutive Merry-Go-Round payments shall be issued a final warning and may temporarily lose eligibility to receive the Merry-Go-Round benefit until all arrears are cleared.
      • A member who continuously defaults on Merry-Go-Round contributions for three consecutive cycles may be suspended from the Merry-Go-Round program by the Admin and Chairlady.
      • If the member fails to regularize payments after suspension, the matter may be presented to the members for further disciplinary action, including possible removal from the chama.
      • Any member facing genuine financial difficulties is encouraged to communicate early with the Admin or Chairlady for consideration and guidance.
    • ⏳ Inactive Members:
      • Members who remain inactive without communication may be issued a warning.
      • Continued inactivity may lead to temporary suspension.
      • Prolonged inactivity may result in removal from the chama.
    • ⚠️ Misconduct and Behavior:
      • Any form of disrespect, dishonesty, or conflict among members is prohibited.
      • Fraud, misuse of funds, or intentional misinformation shall lead to strict disciplinary action.
      • Actions that damage the reputation or unity of the chama shall not be tolerated.
    • 🚫 Disciplinary Measures:
      • Verbal or written warning.
      • Fines or penalties.
      • Suspension from group activities or benefits.
      • Permanent removal from the chama.
    • ⚖️ Right to Fair Hearing:
      • Every member shall be given an opportunity to explain themselves before any major action is taken.
      • Decisions shall be made fairly by the Admin and Chairlady, with member consultation where necessary.

    🔁 Article 8: Exit Policy

    • Definition of Exit:
      • A member shall be considered to have exited the chama upon full withdrawal of their savings.
      • Exit may be voluntary or as a result of disciplinary action.
    • 📢 Notice Requirement:
      • Members intending to exit must notify the Admin in advance.
      • Notice should be given at least 7 days before the intended withdrawal date.
      • This allows proper financial planning and record updates.
    • 📋 Clearance of Obligations:
      • All outstanding loans must be fully repaid before exit.
      • Any pending fines or penalties must be cleared.
      • The member must settle all obligations with the chama before payment is processed.
    • 💰 Processing of Payments:
      • All payments shall be processed within 7 days after official notification and clearance.
      • The exiting member shall receive 100% of their savings after deductions (if any).
      • Payments shall be recorded and confirmed by both the Admin and Chairlady.
    • ⚠️ Limitations:
      • An exited member shall lose access to all chama benefits, including loans and welfare support.
      • Rejoining the chama shall be treated as a new membership and subject to approval.

    ✔️ This Constitution is binding to all members upon approval.

Discover Future Finders Chama Services

At Future Finders Chama Group, we believe that steady saving, mutual support and responsible financial planning can help every member move forward. Our services are designed to encourage a saving culture, strengthen our members and help us grow together.

💰

Savings & Financial Discipline

Build your savings gradually through the Chama’s agreed contribution arrangements. Consistent saving helps members develop financial discipline, build a financial cushion and strengthen their standing within the group.

📊

Member Contributions & Records

Keep track of weekly, monthly and other approved contributions through organised member records. Members can review their savings and contribution information to help them stay informed and accountable.

🔄

Merry-Go-Round

Take part in our rotating group contribution arrangement, where members support one another through scheduled turns. Participation and payout arrangements follow the Chama’s approved rules and contribution requirements.

🏦

Member Loan Services

Eligible members may apply for financial support through the Chama’s loan programme. Applications are considered in line with savings participation, eligibility, available funds and the applicable loan rules. Loan services operate within the Chama’s approved annual schedule.

❤️

Welfare & Member Support

We value standing together during important and difficult moments. Subject to the Chama’s welfare rules and eligibility requirements, support may cover approved needs such as emergencies, weddings and bereavement.

🎲

Lucky Number Draw

Enjoy the Chama’s lucky number draw feature as an engaging member activity. It adds a friendly element of participation and fun to our shared Chama experience.

📣

News, Notices & Updates

Stay up to date with important announcements, meeting information, reminders, changes and other Chama communications through the member platform.

🤝

Member Engagement & Assistance

Connect with the group, take part in meetings, share ideas and seek assistance through the available Chama communication channels. We encourage respectful participation and teamwork.

Growing stronger, together

Our services are guided by the Chama’s constitution, approved policies, contribution schedules and eligibility requirements. Members are encouraged to review the rules and ask for clarification whenever needed. Together, we save, support, grow and succeed.

ℹ️ About Us

Welcome to Future Finders Chama Group – a community of dedicated individuals who believe in the power of saving, supporting, and growing together. We are built on trust, discipline, and a shared vision of financial independence.

🌟 Our Mission

To empower members through disciplined savings, merry-go-round contributions, and access to affordable loans that support financial growth.

👁️ Our Vision

To build a financially independent and empowered community where members grow together and achieve long-term prosperity.

💡 Our Core Values

  • 🤝 Unity & Teamwork
  • 📈 Growth & Prosperity
  • 💰 Financial Discipline
  • 🌍 Community Empowerment
  • 🔍 Transparency & Accountability

📊 What We Do

  • 💰 Encourage consistent saving among members
  • 🔁 Operate a transparent merry-go-round system
  • 🏦 Provide affordable loans based on savings history
  • 🤝 Support members during emergencies and milestones

👥 Who Can Join

Membership is open to disciplined individuals who value commitment, teamwork, and long-term financial growth within a supportive community.

🧑‍💼 Our Leadership

Founded by BONIFACE KAISER, the group is guided by dedicated leaders and members who work together to ensure transparency, accountability, and unity.

📜 Our Journey

Established in January 2024, Future Finders Chama began as a small savings initiative. Today, it has grown into a vibrant community offering savings, loans, investments, and member welfare support.

📅 Our Meetings

Meetings are held online via WhatsApp, where members discuss contributions, loans, updates, and overall group progress.

🎯 Our Long-Term Goals

  • 📈 Build a strong and sustainable investment fund
  • 🏠 Support members with major life and business projects
  • 💼 Create income-generating opportunities
  • 🌍 Promote long-term financial stability for all members

🤝 Our Community Culture

At Future Finders Chama, we value respect, honesty, and accountability. We celebrate achievements together and stand by one another during challenges.

📞 Join or Learn More

Interested in joining or learning more about how we operate? Visit the Membership section or reach out through the Contact page.

👥 Membership Registration Portal

Future Finders Chama Group

Welcome to the Future Finders Chama Group membership portal. New applicants should follow the numbered steps, review the Chama rules and provide complete, accurate information. Existing members should use Member Login instead of submitting a new application.

How to become a member

Follow these five simple steps to submit your membership application. The application form below will guide you through each step, just like the Chama welfare application.

01Review the rulesRead the Chama requirements and understand member responsibilities.
02Choose a categorySelect weekly or monthly Merry-Go-Round contributions.
03Pay the feePay the one-time registration fee and keep your confirmation.
04Fill in your detailsProvide accurate contact, identification and account details.
05Submit for reviewThe administrator will verify your application before approval.
Membership notice: Submitting an application does not mean automatic approval. Your details and payment may be verified by the administrator. Existing members should use Member Login instead of registering again.

📌 Membership & Loan Eligibility

✅ Loan Qualification: A member must actively participate in savings and meet the applicable minimum savings requirement (currently KSh 2,000 for official loan qualification). Members who do not save are not eligible for Chama loans. All applications remain subject to the applicable loan rules and approval.
✅ Official Membership: To become an official member, you must be active in the Chama for a minimum of 4 months and complete the KSh 500 registration fee payment.
✅ Commitment: Members are expected to contribute consistently and maintain good financial discipline.
✅ Support & Trust: Being a member means supporting one another and upholding transparency within the group.

Annual Loan Closure

In accordance with the Future Finders Chama Group Constitution, the annual loan operating period runs from 1 January to 31 October.

Loan services are closed from 1 November to 31 December to allow the chama to prepare for its December activities and the close of the year.

Loan services are scheduled to resume on 1 January.

Thank you for your understanding and continued commitment to Future Finders Chama Group.

✍️ Withdrawal / Exit Application

Use this form only when you voluntarily wish to withdraw from Future Finders Chama Group. It creates a formal written notice under Article 11.1 of the Constitution. Submitting this notice does not end your membership immediately, cancel your contract automatically, erase your records or release you from financial obligations.

Important constitutional timelines
  • Give at least 30 days' written notice before the intended exit date.
  • The Chama reconciles your financial records during the notice period.
  • Financial reconciliation is to be completed within 30 days after the notice period ends.
  • Any eligible settlement is subject to verified savings, approved amounts due, outstanding obligations and lawful deductions.
  • If settlement is delayed by a genuine administrative, verification or financial issue, the Chama should explain the reason and expected settlement date.

Withdrawal is different from suspension or disciplinary termination. This member form is for voluntary withdrawal. A temporary suspension does not automatically end membership (Articles 11.4–11.5). Disciplinary termination is a separate Chama process requiring the constitutional procedure, a reasonable opportunity for the member to respond and applicable appeal rights (Article 11.6). A former member's re-admission is not automatic (Article 11.8).

What happens to your financial records?

The Chama will reconcile your verified personal savings, contributions, loans, repayments, penalties and other obligations. Eligible personal savings are treated separately from Merry-Go-Round and welfare contributions. Registration fees, properly applied fines, penalties and charges are not refundable as savings. Merry-Go-Round contributions are handled under the applicable cycle rules; welfare contributions are not automatically refundable. Any approved reward or benefit is calculated separately where you qualify.

Settlement calculation: Eligible Personal Savings + Approved Amounts Due − Outstanding Obligations and Lawful Deductions. The final amount is determined from official Chama records; this form does not guarantee a particular refund.

If you have an outstanding loan, contribution, penalty, guarantee or other obligation, it remains payable after withdrawal. Where an amount is payable to you, it may first be reconciled against outstanding obligations in accordance with the Constitution and applicable Chama rules.

Member undertaking

I agree to abide by the Future Finders Chama Group Constitution and approved rules; participate according to the plan selected above; make the contributions applicable to my chosen plan on time; act honestly and respectfully; and comply with the group’s approved welfare, savings, loan, discipline, dispute-resolution and exit procedures. Any applicable fees, fines and benefits remain governed by the Constitution and approved rules. Signing does not automatically admit a new applicant; the existing membership approval process still applies. If this form conflicts with the Constitution, the Constitution prevails.
